description: Use when an agent must know when the next US data release or Fed decision lands. Input: optional indicators (cpi, jobs, ppi, jolts, eci, import_prices, gdp, pce, trade, retail_sales, durable_goods, housing_starts, new_home_sales, fomc), days (1-120, default 30). Output: events by time (UTC, ET), period, FOMC projections flag, prior CPI/jobs/PPI values, source links. Example: ?indicators=cpi,jobs,fomc Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

indicators.description: Comma list of cpi, jobs, ppi, jolts, eci, import_prices, gdp, pce, trade, retail_sales, durable_goods, housing_starts, new_home_sales, fomc (default all); unknown → 400 before payment

name: macro_calendar
title: US economic calendar: upcoming CPI, jobs, PPI, GDP, PCE, retail sales and FOMC dates with times and prior values
